candidates.titulo: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
candidates.resumen: Apple’s long-awaited AI overhaul finally makes Siri the assistant it was always supposed to be. Yet it arrives at a moment when simply being a capable AI assistant no longer feels revolutionary.

candidates.titulo: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
candidates.resumen: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step toward decoupling apps from models.
